hero.headline: Material recognition for household plastic
hero.subtext: Our AI judges whether a piece of plastic waste can go into pyrolysis, so mixed and dirty household plastic that mechanical recycling rejects becomes recycled feedstock instead of being incinerated.

home.nicheLine1: A sorting facility asks: which bin does this piece go in?
home.nicheLine2: Asper asks: can this piece become recycled feedstock?
home.nicheDesc: Mechanical recycling needs clean, single-material plastic, so mixed and dirty household plastic is mostly incinerated or landfilled. Pyrolysis can take this plastic, but the material it cannot take must be stopped first.
home.ruleAcceptDesc: Goes into pyrolysis and becomes recycled feedstock.
home.ruleStopDesc: Contains chlorine. In pyrolysis it forms hydrogen chloride, which corrodes the equipment.
home.ruleRouteDesc: Goes back to PET bottle recycling.
home.ruleNote: The accept and stop rules follow the feedstock specification of our affiliate's pyrolysis plant. Every judgment keeps a photo and a timestamp, so it becomes a verifiable waste-reduction record.
home.whyTitle: Backed by a working chemical recycling plant
home.whyDesc: Asper's recognition is backed by a chemical recycling plant in operation, so each judgment upstream matches what the plant downstream can take.
home.whyDownDesc: Our affiliate runs a chemical recycling pyrolysis plant in Dayuan, Taoyuan, and holds ISCC PLUS certification.
home.whyUpDesc: For 'AI sorting + chemical recycling', our affiliate won the circular-regeneration category of ASE Holdings' 3rd Supplier Sustainability Awards. The project expects to recover 43.2 tonnes of household-type plastic a year.
home.whyUpSource: Source: ASE Holdings 2025 Sustainability Report, Responsible Procurement (in Chinese)
home.whyPatentDesc: Taiwan invention patents I933135 (plastic product identification and sorting) and I906713 (liquid-phase pyrolysis of recycled composites).
home.visionStatCaption: Share of the 1,909,496 tonnes of plastic waste collected in Taiwan in 2021 that went to incineration (research estimate, includes non-commodity plastics).
home.visionSource: Source: 黃梓恩 (2023), master's thesis, National Taiwan University (in Chinese)
home.visionLine1: About half of the plastic waste Taiwan collects ends up in incinerators.
home.visionLine2: We want the household plastic in that half to have a chance to become recycled feedstock again.
home.visionPath: We start with corporate sites, then communities, schools and city governments, and finally offer the same judgment to other chemical recyclers.
home.ms1Desc: We have applied for the Ministry of Digital Affairs' compute platform to train the baseline version of our own model.
home.ms2Desc: The recognition service is scheduled to go live at its first corporate site.
home.ms3Desc: Expand the range of materials we can recognize.
home.erpDesc: Asper builds and runs ERP and CRM systems for factories. At our affiliate's pyrolysis plant, employees use them every day: the ERP for attendance, scheduling, and payroll, and the CRM for customers and sample orders.
home.esgDesc: Next, we will turn the photo and timestamp behind every judgment into the data companies need for waste-reduction and ESG reporting.
